units.source_text: 话音未落，他马上就掉头往校门的方向走去，我也折了回去，与他并肩缓步而行。

en.t: Before the words were even finished, he immediately turned around and headed toward the school gate, and I also turned back, walking slowly beside him shoulder to shoulder.

units.source_text: 柏木告诉我："光俱乐部"的学生主任作为金融黑市的嫌疑犯被逮捕了，

en.t: Kashiwagi told me that the student director of the "Hikari Club" had been arrested as a suspect in the financial black market,

units.source_text: 9月被释放后，信用一落千丈，眼下处境十分困难。

en.t: and after being released in September, his credit had collapsed completely, leaving him in extremely difficult circumstances at present.

units.source_text: 从今春起，"光俱乐部"主任就引起了柏木的很大兴趣，他不时出现在我们的话题中。

en.t: Since this spring, the director of the "Hikari Club" had greatly interested Kashiwagi, and he would appear in our conversations from time to time.

units.source_text: 柏木和我都确信他是社会的强者，没想到仅仅两周之后他就企图自杀了。

en.t: Kashiwagi and I were both convinced that he was one of society's strong men, but unexpectedly, only two weeks later, he attempted suicide.
